page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. This instance is configured with 4 virtual CPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

A primary characteristic of this instance is its shared CPU allocation model, which influences its performance profile under sustained workloads. The instance does not feature any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps, and there are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with the deployment.

Due to the shared CPU resource model and lack of bundled local storage or dedicated network bandwidth, this instance represents a budget-oriented tier. It is designed for workloads that do not require continuous maximum CPU utilization or high-speed local disk access. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, development environments, basic code compilation, and non-critical background tasks that can tolerate shared-resource performance variability.
